facts: Identity check at reconciliation (v5 D9): JCPDS 44-0141 = alpha-MnO2, hollandite-type (2x2 tunnels), tetragonal I4/m (No. 87); not rutile-type; rutile-type (P4_2/mnm): no. Identity check at reconciliation (v5 D9): gamma-MnO2 = nsutite, a disordered intergrowth of ramsdellite and pyrolusite with no single space group; not the rutile-type MnO2 (that is beta-MnO2, pyrolusite); rutile-type (P4_2/mnm): no.
